units.source_text: ——事后回想起来，这次与母亲相会，在我的心灵上产生了很大的影响。

en.t: Looking back on it afterward, this meeting with my mother had a very great effect on my heart.

units.source_text: 如果说这时候我发现母亲始终生活在与我不同的另一个世界里，

en.t: If it was at this time that I realized my mother had always lived in another world different from my own,

units.source_text: 那么也是这时候，母亲的想法开始对我产生巨大的作用。

en.t: then it was also at this time that my mother's way of thinking began to exert a tremendous influence on me.
